name: weather
description: Minimalistische Wetter App (vanilla TS, esbuild, self-hosted Inter OFL, Lucide ISC, Wetterdaten Open-Meteo CC BY 4.0).

scripts.build:css: esbuild styles-app.css --minify --legal-comments=inline --target=es2020 > styles-app.min.css && esbuild styles-pages.css --minify --legal-comments=inline --target=es2020 > styles-pages.min.css
scripts.build:dist: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html impressum.html datenschutz.html 404.html 404.css 404.js theme-init.js sw.js site.webmanifest browserconfig.xml robots.txt LICENSES.md favicon.ico favicon.svg favicon-*.png safari-pinned-tab.svg apple-touch-icon.png icon-*.png mstile-150x150.png og-image-*.png styles-app.min.css styles-pages.min.css script.min.js script.min.js.map dist/ && cp -R fonts dist/fonts
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:dist
